scope: Historical evidence coverage of exact variants; not percentage predictive accuracy or percentage likelihood of correct performance. Six modeled + six proposed research-intake variants. Source search and rank only; no physics roster admission.

method.scoring: Expert-audited coverage points / 100. Category points require usable source identity, directness and condition match; 0=none, full points=well-supported over relevant flight envelope. Nominal engine tables, unrelated airframes and simulations receive deliberately limited credit. Human judgment, not statistical error bars.
hard_gates: Original-source stall or CLmax at controlled flight mass and correct configuration
CAS/EAS or demonstrably corrected* near the actual stall with documented measurement domain, while explicitly separating instrument error
Installed power/prop/cooling and independent measured speed/climb
Independent or adequately bounded sustained-turn energy/drag evidence with uncertainty
method.qualification: Reaching 85% alone never bypasses a hard gate. CAS* only provisional. No extrapolation outside original correction source range, no cross-airframe transfer without method justification, no double-count of identical trial represented in multiple packs.
